name: PSweet
source:
Welcome to PVillage...
... a town in cyberspace, and home of the PSuite set of productivity applications. Here you'll work for LUX, solve a few mysteries, and get closer with the programs and processes of the *worst* productivity suite ever created!

How? By dating them, silly! 

Experience a hand-drawn, computer-pixellated world of retro 90s weirdness.

Battle, hide, sing,  use knowledge of swordsmanship and [only the finest] brandy in your quest to connect to the Inter-Net, and unlock the secrets of the programs of PontiSuite.

[From [url=https://futureproof.itch.io/psweet]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到P村……
……这是一座位于赛博空间的小镇，也是办公软件套装PSuite的大本营。在这里，你将为LUX公司效力，解开几桩谜案，并与史上“最烂”办公套件里的各个程序与进程拉近距离！

怎么拉近距离？当然是和它们约会啦，小傻瓜！

沉浸于纯手绘结合电脑像素风的复古90年代怪诞世界之中吧。

在努力连上“因特·网”、揭开PontiSuite旗下众程序秘密的旅途中，尽情去战斗、躲藏、歌唱，并巧妙运用你的剑术知识与（唯选上乘的）白兰地吧。

[摘自[url=https://futureproof.itch.io/psweet]Itch.io[/url]]
